sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Player WHERE teamId IS NULL;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `Match` WHERE homeGoals IS NULL AND awayGoals IS NULL;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT playerId FROM Appearance GROUP BY playerId HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2) AS qualifying_players;

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN m.homeTeamId = t.teamId THEN COALESCE(m.homeGoals, 0) ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN m.awayTeamId = t.teamId THEN COALESCE(m.awayGoals, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM Team AS t JOIN `Match` AS m ON m.homeTeamId = t.teamId OR m.awayTeamId = t.teamId WHERE t.name = 'Real Madrid';
